title: Volpone; Or, The Fox
author: Ben Jonson
description: "Volpone; Or, The Fox" by Ben Jonson is a comedy play first produced in 1605–1606.
longDescription: In this merciless satire of greed and lust, a wealthy Venetian pretends to be dying to trick three greedy men hoping to inherit his fortune.

authorInfo.bio: Ben Jonson (–1637) wrote Volpone; Or, The Fox. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
